Name: Measures sit in a display folder
Description: Every measure goes in a display folder, so the field list stays easy to browse as the model grows.

Name: Measures are visible
Description: Reads Visible, which a measure does not have, so the rule cannot run.

Name: Every table, measure, and relationship
Description: Reports each object in its scope, apart from those whose ignore annotation names this rule.

Name: A rule that names no scope
Description: Has no Scope, so pbiplint cannot tell which objects it reads.

Name: Columns store decimals, not floating point numbers
Description: A column of floating point numbers can round sums in surprising ways; store a fixed decimal instead.

Name: Each table takes part in a relationship
Description: A copy of a published rule with its expression laid out on two lines and its scopes in another order, so pbiplint runs its own rule.

Name: Foreign key columns are hidden
Description: A copy of a published rule at a lower severity than the published one, so pbiplint runs its own rule at this severity.
Expression:
UsedInRelationships.Any(FromColumn.Name == current.Name and FromCardinality == "Many")

and

IsHidden == false

Name: Visible measures have a description
Description: A copy of a published rule narrowed to measures, so it runs as the team's rule in place of pbiplint's.
